name: The Basin
description: Sand to the horizon with racks standing out of it like fenceposts, and a heat shimmer that has been there since the cooling failed. Something is still drawing power down there.

variants.description: Sand to the horizon, racks standing out of it, and a man on the north ridge who has been up there eleven days because somebody in Kell finally handed out rifles.
Sand to the horizon and nobody on the ridge. The Ash Camp crews went south the year the stronghold fell, and the Basin belongs to the heat now.
